The '''''Bloodskull''''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] airship owned by [[Ramchak]] who was operating in conjunction with [[Aveca Dunn]].

==History==
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the pirates on the ''Bloodskull'' attacked the Dooku airship [[Windrunner/Legends|''Windrunner'']] with the intention of capturing [[Bron Dooku]]. The pirates then boarded the ''Windrunner'' using cables, engaging the airship's security force while Vex snuck aboard to snatch Bron. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agent [[Jahan Cross]] pursued Vex to the ''Bloodskull'' and commandeered one of the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] mounted to the deck. He then used the weapon to blow a hole in the hull, critically damaging the ship.
